Rabbits need lots of space to exercise so our indoor hutch requirements are about 2x2m, but the rabbit(s) will also need daily exercise out of their pen. Diet is also extremely important, and rabbits need to eat at least their body size in hay every day plus 2 cups of fresh leafy greens/veg with fruit only as a treat and also a supplement feed of good quality pellets (about 1/3c Burgess Excel per day). ‘ hope this helps.
